# Perform Pesaran CD test

<small>Source: [`man/performPesaranTest.Rd`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/man/performPesaranTest.Rd) · Help: `?performPesaranTest`</small>

Checks for cross-sectional dependence in panel residuals.

## Usage

```r
performPesaranTest(model, data = NULL, id, time)
```

## Arguments

`model`
:   an object of class `lm`.

`data`
:   data frame used to fit `model`. When `NULL`, the default, the model frame of `model` is used, so `id` and `time` must then be variables of the model. The model frame holds the terms of the model rather than its variables (`log(x)` rather than `x`), so a model that transforms a variable needs `data`, as does a model with an `offset()` term.

`id`
:   individual identifier column.

`time`
:   time column.

## Value

An object of class `htest`.

## Details

The statistic averages pairwise correlation coefficients of the residuals and is standardized to follow a normal distribution under the null of independence.

## References

Pesaran, M. H. (2004). General diagnostic tests for cross section dependence in panels. *Cambridge Working Papers in Economics*.

## Examples

```r
 df <- data.frame(id = rep(1:3, each = 5), time = rep(1:5, 3), x = runif(15), y = rnorm(15))
 m <- lm(y ~ x, data = df)
 performPesaranTest(m, df, "id", "time")
```
